description: E6reuse with the execution credential: the shared MCP server's sessions share one keep-alive pool (httpx or aiohttp) to two destinations; permissive executions may use both, restricted ones only the first. The runtime switches the credential with prctl(PR_FACT) before each send; the BPF LSM program on socket_sendmsg re-authorizes every send by the sending task's credential, and the kernel charges the bytes each send accepted and each receive returned to the credential (cred_usage.json). Reference: the destination's per-request log (which operations' requests arrived, and their byte ranges).
